provider: hf-mirror.com / hf-mirror.net (Hugging Face mirror — read-only proxy)

free_tier.stated: None of its own — it is a transparent reverse proxy. Its published conditions say so explicitly: it is a '非盈利性、公共人工智能技术基础设施加速节点' (non-profit public AI infra acceleration node) that '仅为 ... 提供透明网络代理与下载分发加速支持' (only provides transparent proxying and download acceleration), and '本站 ... 本身不产生或修改上游内容' (this site does not itself produce or modify upstream content).
free_tier.notes: the headline offer as the seed recorded it; the binding constraint is in limits[]

per_object_cap.notes: extracted from the quota or limits prose

retention.stated: no retention statement was extracted from the seed's quota and limits prose; absence here is a gap in this conversion, not a vendor claim that retention is unlimited
retention.notes: extraction found no retention clause; the seed's limits text may still state one, see extras.limits_verbatim

egress.terms: Free and anonymous for reads; resolves to HF's own CDN. Not applicable as a storage delta — the bytes live on HF, which is already known and excluded as a discovery.

tooling: Drop-in hostname swap: HF_ENDPOINT=https://hf-mirror.com for huggingface_hub / hf_transfer / rclone (rclone 'hf' backend points at it).
chaining: Only as an egress accelerator for an HF dataset you already have — it is a CDN in front of a host already on the known list, not a new quota. Worth noting for the serving workload (500 GB-1 TiB/day): it is an extra free CDN edge for HF pulls from mainland China, and its published conditions place '高频非法盗链或恶意耗尽公用网络资源' (hotlinking to exhaust shared bandwidth) outside the allocation.
limits_note: per-object-cap: inherits HF (50 GB/file at the time of the linked HF issues). Retention: inherits HF. Write path is redirected straight to huggingface.co, not mirrored: probe POST /api/repos/create -> 308 Location: https://huggingface.co/api/repos/create. So the mirror gives you nothing new to store INTO.

reliability_note: Reads work; the published conditions reserve the right to block addresses that exceed the allocation and disclaim all availability ('按现状 AS-IS'). One probe returned a bare 200 with an HTML body from the LFS batch endpoint rather than JSON — parse the body, not the status.
